decisions: Why Mutex<PluginHost> (vs. plain PluginHost): Tauri's State<T> derefs to &T, no &mut reachable from run-event callback; Mutex gives interior mutability for shutdown_all.
Why switch .run(generate_context!()) to .build(generate_context!())...run(callback): callback exposes RunEvent::Exit so we can hook shutdown_all.
Why PluginHost as separate Tauri state (not in AppState): keeps AppState::build() unchanged (smaller change footprint per CLAUDE.md §2.4).

decisions.decision: Choose Tauri v2 over Electron / Flutter Desktop / MAUI / Avalonia / Wails / Qt
decisions.rationale: Best balance of native feel, bundle size, AI-friendliness, license cleanliness for Win11 + macOS26 cross-platform desktop

decisions.decision: Switch ship pipeline to release build after M1.1 user feedback about console window
decisions.rationale: Debug build leaves conhost console window orphaned after quit; release build has PE subsystem = GUI which prevents console allocation

decisions.decision: Use cargo build --release --features tauri/custom-protocol (M1.3) → tauri build --no-bundle (M2.17-C3)
decisions.rationale: tauri build auto-runs beforeBuildCommand (= npm run build) AND auto-enables custom-protocol; eliminates stale-dist and dist-not-embedded failure modes at the source

decisions.decision: Smoke test must verify structural markers (WebView2 child window class + dist fingerprint in exe + window title), not just process running
decisions.rationale: Original 4-test smoke test passed even with blank/stale/ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED pages — false positive; Test 5/6/7 catch the regression classes

decisions.decision: CLAUDE.md placed in project root (not global) per user choice 2026-06-19
decisions.rationale: User wanted project-specific rules to follow the project, not all projects globally

decisions.decision: macOS impls are compile-only stubs (no runtime tests) on Windows dev box
decisions.rationale: Cross-compile target = apple-darwin not set up; macOS stubs satisfy trait contracts for cargo check; real Mac validation deferred to L-M2.09/11/12

decisions.decision: 12 plugin stubs each returning placeholder UI; M2.x business logic lives in services/ + commands/, NOT in plugin init hooks
decisions.rationale: Plugin architecture is verified (M1.3); business logic layered in service/command path per project policy; PluginHost was never wired to lib.rs::run until M2.17-3.1 (this commit)
Avoid main session context pollution + ensure subagent quality; matches GSD guidance
